sources.title: Train an SO-101 Robot From Sim-to-Real With NVIDIA Isaac
sources.snippet: Overview # You'll train and deploy a vision-language-action (VLA) model to perform unstructured pick-and-place of centrifuge vials into a rack using an SO-101 robot arm - first in sim, where we can iterate quickly and validate behavior, then in reality.
